subject: general
question: Who is the author of the poetry 'Chand Pukhraj Ka'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulzar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulzar** is the author of the poetry 'Chand Pukhraj Ka'.
 
• Gulzar is a renowned Indian poet, lyricist, and film director.
 
• He has been awarded the Padma Bhushan, the third-highest civilian award in India, for his contribution to the arts.
 
• Gulzar's work is known for its deep emotional impact and lyrical quality.
 
• 'Chand Pukhraj Ka' is one of his celebrated works, reflecting his mastery in poetry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gulzar** was born as Sampooran Singh Kalra in 1934.
 
• He started his career in the Indian film industry as a lyricist with the song "Mora Gora Ang Lai Le" from the movie Bandini (1963).
 
• Gulzar has won numerous awards including several National Film Awards, Filmfare Awards, and an Academy Award for Best Original Song for "Jai Ho" from the film Slumdog Millionaire.
 
• His poetry often addresses themes of love, loss, and the human experience, resonating deeply with readers and audiences.
 
• Besides poetry and lyrics, Gulzar has also directed several acclaimed films and television series.
